**Job Description**
The AI Software Engineer designs, develops, and maintains AI-powered software that supports United Imaging’s business operations, combining strong software engineering skills with hands-on experience applying large language models. The engineer works with business users across quality, manufacturing, finance, HR, and R&D to translate operational needs into reliable software solutions, ensuring stability, security, and maintainability. Responsibilities include gathering requirements, defining system functionality, developing algorithms, and writing production code, primarily in Python and TypeScript.
  
  
In this role, you will focus on applied AI for Speed, United Imaging’s in-house AI workspace platform. Speed gives employees an AI assistant and AI agents that work across company files, collaboration tools such as Lark and Microsoft Outlook, and business systems: answering questions, analyzing documents and spreadsheets, running Python analyses in a secure sandbox, automating approval and reporting workflows, and supporting quality reviews of manufacturing records. **Key Responsibilities**

* Understanding of the business operational process and providing software solutions.
* Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation to identify requirements and solutions.
* Produce specifications and determine operational feasibility, integrate software components into a fully functional software system, develop software verification plans and quality assurance procedures
* Document and maintain software functionality, comply with project plans and process requirements, deploy programs, evaluate feedback and upgrade software.
* Design and build LLM-powered features for Speed, including tool-calling AI agents, multi-step workflow automation, and conversational assistants grounded in company documents and business systems.
* Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge-base capabilities: document parsing (PDF, Word, Excel, scanned forms), chunking, embeddings, vector search, and answers that cite their sources.
* Apply AI to document review in regulated workflows, such as AI-assisted review of medical device manufacturing and quality records (e.g., Device History Records), with human-in-the-loop sign-off and full traceability.
* Build evaluation pipelines for AI features (labeled datasets, offline replay of real runs, precision/recall and task-success metrics, regression checks for prompt and model changes) and use them to drive measurable quality improvements.
* Integrate and operate commercial LLM APIs and self-hosted open-weight models, balancing quality, latency, and token cost through model routing, context management, and prompt caching, while meeting enterprise data-privacy and security requirements.
* Partner with business users in quality, manufacturing, finance, HR, and R&D to identify high-value AI use cases, prototype quickly, ship to production, and measure adoption and impact.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields
* Proficient in Python and TypeScript, with experience using source code management tools such as Git.
* Hands-on experience building and shipping applications on large language models (e.g., OpenAI GPT, or open-weight models such as Qwen or Llama), including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, and streaming.
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): embeddings, vector search (e.g., pgvector or a dedicated vector database), and evaluating retrieval quality.
* Strong Python skills, including building backend services and REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI, asynchronous programming).
* Experience designing quantitative evaluations for AI/ML systems (test sets, metrics, error analysis) and using the results to guide improvements.
* Complex problem-solving skills and Critical thinking, strong interest in technology and strong IT skills
* Communications skills and professional proficiency in written and spoken English

* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Lark or Microsoft 365 (Graph API) through OAuth and REST APIs.
* Experience with Medical Imaging related projects
* Passion for solving complex technical challenges with innovative ideas

**Why NinjaTech AI**
We are building the unmetered intelligence workforce: autonomous AI agents that do real, end-to-end work for enterprises instead of just answering questions. Since founding in 2022 we have gone from research to agents running production workloads inside real companies, on secure, isolated infrastructure, backed by SRI International, DCVC, and Candou Ventures. If you want the shortest possible line between what you build and the outcomes it creates, this is a rare seat.
  
  
**Why this role exists**
When we close a large enterprise deal, the contract is the start of the hard part, not the end. The customer has bought an outcome, an "unmetered intelligence workforce" doing real work inside their business, and someone has to make that outcome real, fast, inside their systems, their security constraints, and their messy data. That someone is the Applied AI Engineer. We attach an Applied AI Engineer to every large enterprise account. They embed with the customer, build the first high-value agentic workflows on our platform, and own technical success from kickoff through go-live and expansion. The Applied AI Engineer is how a signed contract becomes a renewed and expanded one.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Land the deployment. Embed with a newly-closed enterprise customer, rapidly learn their operations and data, and stand up the first production agent workflows on NinjaTech in weeks, not quarters.
* Build custom, tailored solutions. Wire our platform into the customer's real systems (their data sources, identity, ticketing, CRMs, internal APIs) and build the bespoke automations, prompts, tools, and guardrails that make agents useful for their jobs-to-be-done.
* Be the technical face of NinjaTech in the room. Run working sessions with everyone from the customer's frontline operators to their CISO and CTO. Translate their vision into an architecture, and translate our platform into their language.
* Drive adoption and expansion. A deployment that isn't used doesn't renew. Instrument usage, hunt for the next high-value workflow, and turn a beachhead into an org-wide rollout. Your success metric is customer outcomes that drive net revenue retention.
* Clear enterprise gauntlets. Own the technical side of security review, isolated-VM/data-residency requirements, SSO/SCIM, SOC 2 / DPA questionnaires,and procurement's technical due diligence.
* Close the loop to Product. You see what breaks in the field first. Feed sharp, prioritized signal back to core engineering; occasionally upstream a fix or a reusable component so the next deployment is faster.

* Engineering background. You're a genuine builder. Proficient in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or Go; comfortable across data plumbing, APIs, and a bit of front-end when a demo needs it.

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.
  
  
David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we've brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.
  
  
Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We're looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.
  
  
**About Our Engineering Team**
At David AI, our engineers build the pipelines, platforms, and models that transform raw audio into high-signal data for leading AI labs and enterprises. We're a tight-knit team of product engineers, infrastructure specialists, and machine learning experts focused on building the world's first audio data research company.
  
  
We move fast, own our work end-to-end, and ship to production daily. Our team designs real-time pipelines handling terabytes of speech data and deploys cutting-edge generative audio models.
  
  
**About This Role**
We generate audio data for the world’s leading speech and audio labs. Data only matters if it makes a customer’s model measurably better, and finding out whether it does is your job. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, Production, you’ll own the loop between a customer’s model, our research team, and our data production. In a typical week you’ll run an ablation on Monday, see a signal on Tuesday, change how we collect data on Wednesday, and ship a recommendation that makes it to the customer by Friday. You’ll be shipping something on the order of days, not weeks.
  
  
This role is for someone who is equally comfortable in a codebase, translating customer requirements into how we produce data, and in the details of how we ship product features to yield data that improves our customers’ models. You’ll care about why a model regressed, and also about which recording setup, product experience, or automated QA step caused it.
  
  
****In this role, you will****

* Run the daily experiment loop. Turn customer questions into fast, rigorous experiments, get results in days, and iterate until the answer is clear enough to act on.
* Design ablations and benchmarks that change decisions. Work with our research engineers to isolate what drives model behavior. Then translate the results into concrete changes in what we collect, how we collect it, and how we filter and weight it.
* Develop operational intuition for data quality. Get close to how our data is produced, including recording conditions, contributor pools, annotation, and QA, so you can trace model outcomes back to operational causes and fix them at the source.
* Build the tooling that makes speed possible. Ship the eval harnesses, pipelines, and analysis tools that make the next experiment faster than the last, across every customer.
* Close the loop with the model improvement lifecycle. Make sure what you learn changes what we produce, so our data keeps improving the models that depend on it.
* Shape how we work. Help define our experimentation practices, engineering culture, and roadmap as the team grows.

****Your background looks like****

* AI-native coding experience with a track record of fast, impact-driven experiments and product features across the stack.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team.
* Ability to translate open-ended research questions into concrete experiments and clear recommendations.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to both researchers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Desire to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt quickly as the audio AI field evolves.
* Excited to join our team in-person in San Francisco.

****Bonus points if you have****

* At least 3 years of relevant engineering or product experience (product engineering, ML engineering, or applied research)
* Degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with audio or speech models, or with audio/signal data more broadly.
* Familiarity with machine learning research workflows — training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and metrics.
* Experience working directly with technical or enterprise customers.

Summary
We are seeking a qualified Litigation Assistant to join our team. As a Litigation Assistant, you will be responsible for managing the law firm's day-to-day operations, including carrying out administrative services and supporting the legal team. This position's ideal candidate has a strong work ethic, exceptional problem-solving skills, and comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic workplace.
Responsibilities
Perform administrative duties (scheduling calendar hearings and deadlines, organize case files, manage logistics)
Maintain pleadings and discovery indexes.
Organize exhibits, documents, evidence, briefs, and appendices.
Implement and improve upon administrative processes for more efficient workflow.
Collect, examine, and organize evidence and other legal documents for attorney review and case preparation
Draft and proofread correspondence and legal documents, such as pleadings and contracts
Research regulations, laws, and legal articles to assist with the preparation of reports, case files, and legal advice
Manage client billing by preparing, finalizing, and sending out bills, as well as resolving billing issues in cooperation with the billing attorney
Communicate with clients and witnesses to schedule meetings, interviews, and depositions
Manage, organize, and maintain documents in paper or electronic filing systems
Performs other related duties as assigned to meet the needs of the business.
Qualification
High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required.
Associates degree in paralegal studies, a paralegal certificate, or a bachelor's degree is preferred.
Bilingual English and Spanish
At least 2 years of experience as an administrative assistant (preferably in a law firm or in a corporate legal department), legal assistant, legal secretary, or paralegal.
Experience in Personal Injury, WC, Premises, or other injury related practice areas. (preferred)
Must possess the ability to multi-task, prioritize, handle a fast-paced environment, and manage workload with a great attitude and minimal supervision.
Great written and communication skills, be proficient in calendar depositions, mediation, and hearings.
Applicable knowledge of motions, discovery, evidence, litigation documentation, court rules, and procedures, practices, etc.
Highly organized with the ability to juggle multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Strong writing and communication skills along with attention to detail
Extensive computer and database expertise, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and type no less than 35 wpm
This role is on-site, which gives you the chance to be fully immersed in the work and gain direct experience alongside the team .
